Name: Fix for The Stray Catfe and SVE's Immersive Farm 2 Remastered
Author: UlyanaLeyana
Description:
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753?tab=files]Immersive Farm 2 Remastered[/url] wasn't compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5533]The Stray Catfe[/url], so this fix was created by requests. So if you are want to play with these mods then these fixes are for you.

[b][color=#cc0000][size=4]Install[/size][/color][/b][list=1]
[*]Install the latest version of[url=https://smapi.io/] SMAPI[/url]﻿.
[*]Install the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿﻿  version 1.20.0 or higher and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753?tab=files]Immersive Farm 2 Remastered[/url].﻿
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
[*]Run the game using SMAPI once to generate config.json
[*]Editing config.json file allows you to turn fixes on or off (at the moment there is only one, but there will be more if any other incompatibilities appear).
[/list]
[b]Config options[/b]:
"IF2R": "true" "false" ("Default": "true")

Enjoy!
